title: Ubutegetsi Budacogora
intro: Mu bihugu bya kera, hari ubutegetsi bukomeye bwahoze butegeka, butegeka umutungo mwinshi n'ubuzima bw'abantu batabarika. Nubwo hari ibimenyetso n'imiburo bigaragara, uyu mutegetsi yahisemo inzira yo kwigomeka, biganisha ku guhangana gukomeye kwari kugaragara uko ibihe byagiye bisimburana.
clues: Navuze ko mfite ububasha n'ububasha ku butegetsi bunini.
Nahinyuje intumwa yicisha bugufi yoherejwe n'Umwami w'ijuru ryose.
Abaturage banjye bari bazwiho ubuhanga mu kubaka inyubako nini n'uruzi rwadufashije mu iterambere ryacu.
Nabonye ibimenyetso byinshi by'igitangaza, birimo inkoni yahindutse inzoka n'ikiganza cyaka cyane.
Nanze ko itsinda ry'abantu babaye abacakara bava mu gihugu cyanjye, nubwo Imana yabibategetse.
Gukurikirana abantu bari kugenda byatumye njye n'ingabo zanjye tugera mu nyanja yari yagabanyijemo kabiri.

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
